modos.descricao: Revela um Garou como Skindancer (Wyrm). Removido do pack para o Hunting Grounds como Enemy.

_metadata.texto_original: Choose 1 Garou. Successful vote means that the Garou is revealed as being a Skindancer (thus of the Wyrm and considered an enemy card) and is removed from his pack and placed in the Hunting Grounds. It is still worth victory points if destroyed.
